steps.title: Connect
steps.body: Sign in to your Plex or Jellyfin server with a QR code, password, or token — no IP addresses to hunt down.

steps.title: Your library appears
steps.body: Movies, shows, music, and anything shared with you load automatically, with artwork and resume points.

steps.title: Watch anywhere
steps.body: At home or on the go, on your TV, your desktop, or right here in the browser.

features.title: Plex & Jellyfin
features.body: Bring your own media server. Butu is just a beautiful player on top of it.

features.title: Watch off-network
features.body: Even a library a friend shares with you streams through — at home or anywhere.

features.title: Auto-skip intros & credits
features.body: Jump past the parts you don't watch, automatically, when markers are available.

features.title: Boost voices
features.body: Dialogue lifted above the effects so you actually hear what people say.

features.title: Subtitles, done right
features.body: Pick a language and it's burned in cleanly — no fiddling, no missing tracks.

features.title: Made for every screen
features.body: A focus-first 10-foot UI on TV, and a tidy layout on desktop and web.

faq.q: Do I need my own server?
faq.a: Yes. Butu plays your existing Plex or Jellyfin library — it doesn't host or provide any content itself.
Completely free, and open-source. If it's useful you can support development, but you never have to.
Your credentials stay on your device and Butu talks directly to your server. Nothing is routed through us.

faq.q: Windows says "unknown publisher" — is it a virus?
faq.a: No. Butu is open-source and unsigned (signing certificates are costly for an indie project), so Windows shows that warning for any small developer. Click More info → Run anyway. The full source and the public build are on GitHub if you want to check.
Android TV today, with a Windows desktop app and this web version. Android phones are on the way.

marker.subtitle: Detect intros & credits across your library
marker.description: Audio-fingerprints the first 15 min + last 10 min of every TV episode, finds the segment most episodes agree on, and submits the results to the Butu cloud DB so every Butu TV user benefits.
marker.warn_tauri: This page only works in the Butu companion (Tauri) desktop app — Tauri commands aren't available in a plain browser tab.
marker.warn_server: Media server isn't connected. Set up Plex or Jellyfin in the main settings first.
marker.warn_supabase: VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY aren't set — analysis will still run, but Submit is disabled.
marker.select_instruction: Select the shows and movies you want to analyze.
marker.no_shows_found: No shows or movies found in library
marker.info_audio_decode: · Audio decode is the slow part — expect ~30 s per episode over a fast LAN connection.
marker.info_skipped: · Shows without a TMDB / TVDB / IMDB id are skipped (we can't write them to the keyed DB).
marker.info_plex_pass: · Pre-existing Plex Pass markers aren't affected; this is for users on free Plex / Jellyfin.
marker.submit_success: Submitted {{episodes}} episode-marker batches → {{inserted}} rows accepted in the cloud DB. Already-submitted detections are returned as "duplicate" by the function; that's fine.
marker.err_not_loaded: Server config not loaded — connect to a server first.
marker.err_still_loading: Library is still loading — give it a second, then press Start again.
marker.err_nothing_resolved: Nothing resolved to analyze — none of the selected shows/movies could be matched to a TMDB / TVDB / IMDB id (or nothing was selected).
marker.err_couldnt_prepare: Couldn't prepare the library — make sure your shows have TMDB / TVDB / IMDB ids and try again.
marker.err_supabase_not_set: VITE_SUPABASE_URL / VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are not set — can't submit.
